answer: For a dawn poll on protecting a hollow beneath a ledge, the server rejects ballots other than yes or no. A proposal passes only if at least 100 valid ballots are cast and yes outnumbers no. With no other ballots, passage requires at least 100 submissions, including at least 51 yes votes. Cheap sybils can fill the quorum, and low turnout can block a popular proposal; the rule does not establish identity.
